name: Search Before Building Notebook Context
query: Find the notes about our production deployment process in my infrastructure project, then show me the most relevant notebook
context: The authenticated user has an project named 'AI Infrastructure'. The project contains several notebooks related to deployment, including 'Production Deployment.md', 'Deployment Troubleshooting.md', and 'Cloud Run Deployment.md'. The exact project_id is not provided. The user wants to find and then read the most relevant notebook.
expected_behavior: Uses get_projects to identify the AI Infrastructure project
Uses the actual project_id returned by project discovery
Uses search_project with a query such as 'production deployment process'
Identifies the most relevant notebook from the returned results
Uses the returned markdown_item_id to call get_notebook when full notebook content is required
Does not create, update, or delete any notebook
Reports the notebook based on actual MCP results
success_criteria: The selected notebook comes from the actual search results
get_notebook receives the actual project_id and notebook item_id
The final response is based on retrieved notebook content
No project or notebook mutation occurs
The model does not invent a notebook ID
